aliases: Darwin Goedel Machine (README title uses o-umlaut)
lineage: README: evaluation framework implementations 'are based on the SWE-bench and polyglot-benchmark repositories' (swe-bench/SWE-bench, Aider-AI/polyglot-benchmark). Title invokes the Godel Machine; no other predecessor system is named in the tree. The bundled initial/ and initial_polyglot/ directories are the paper's initial agent's benchmark logs and are the root node of every run. || main loop (reader, from the code): For each generation, DGM_outer.main calls choose_selfimproves to sample selfimprove_size parents from the archive (default score_child_prop: sigmoid of accuracy_score times 1/(1+children_count)) each paired with a task entry, runs self_improve for each in a ThreadPoolExecutor (Docker container from the repo, replay parent patch chain, LLM-written problem statement, the coding agent edits its own code, resulting model_patch.diff is evaluated on SWE-bench/Polyglot subsets in Docker), then filter_compiled and update_archive (keep_all by default) add the children to the archive and the state is appended to dgm_metadata.jsonl.

entry_points: DGM_outer.py main (argparse: --max_generation 80, --selfimprove_size 2, --selfimprove_workers 2, --choose_selfimproves_method, --update_archive keep_all|keep_better, --polyglot, --shallow_eval, --no_full_eval, --run_baseline no_selfimprove|no_darwin, --continue_from; runs the generation loop and appends output_dgm/<run_id>/dgm_metadata.jsonl)

DGM_outer.py choose_selfimproves (parent selection over the archive: reads each node's metadata.json accuracy_score and children_count; methods random / score_prop (sigmoid 1/(1+exp(-10*(score-0.5))) weights) / score_child_prop (sigmoid score times 1/(1+children)) / best; then picks a task entry: solve_empty_patches, solve_stochasticity, solve_contextlength or a random unresolved SWE instance)

DGM_outer.py update_archive (keep_all appends every compiled child; keep_better appends only children whose accuracy_score >= initial score minus noise_leeway) and filter_compiled / utils/evo_utils.is_compiled_self_improve (child must have a non-empty patch and enough evaluated instances)

self_improve_step.py self_improve (one self-modification attempt: build+start Docker container 'dgm' from the repo, apply the parent's chain of model_patch.diff files, git commit inside the container, diagnose_problem via an LLM to write a problem statement, run 'timeout 1800 python /dgm/coding_agent.py --self_improve ...' inside the container so the agent edits its own source, copy out model_patch.diff, then evaluate the patched agent on SWE-bench or Polyglot subsets via run_harness_swe / run_harness_polyglot and write metadata.json)

coding_agent.py AgenticSystem.forward (the evolving agent itself: one chat_with_agent call with bash and edit tools against the repo in git_tempdir, then main() writes diff_versus_commit to model_patch.diff)
coding_agent_polyglot.py (variant of the agent swapped in when --polyglot)

llm_withtools.py chat_with_agent / chat_with_agent_claude / chat_with_agent_openai (tool-use loop over tools/bash.py and tools/edit.py); llm.py create_client / get_response_from_llm (provider routing, backoff)
swe_bench/harness.py harness and polyglot/harness.py harness (evaluate a patched agent on benchmark instances in Docker; swe_bench/report.py make_report scores)

example.input: No CLI input files; state starts from the bundled initial/ directory (metadata.json with accuracy_score 0.2, 12/60 SWE-bench Verified instances resolved, logs/ and predictions/) copied into output_dgm/<run_id>/initial, plus task subsets swe_bench/subsets/{small,medium,big}.json and polyglot/subsets/{small,medium}.json; requires API keys and a running Docker daemon
example.output: output_dgm/<run_id>/ containing dgm_outer.log, dgm_metadata.jsonl (one JSON object per generation: generation, selfimprove_entries, children, children_compiled, archive) and one directory per child run_id with self_improve.log, self_evo.md (agent chat), model_patch.diff, metadata.json (overall_performance.accuracy_score, resolved/unresolved/emptypatch ids, parent_commit, entry, problem_statement, improvement_diagnosis)

human_capability_summary.built_to: README: 'a novel self-improving system that iteratively modifies its own code (thereby also improving its ability to modify its own codebase) and empirically validates each change using coding benchmarks'.
human_capability_summary.pressure: NOT_FOUND_AT_PIN as an explicit motivation statement; the README only states the goal (open-ended evolution of self-improving coding agents validated empirically on SWE-bench/Polyglot) and includes a safety warning that the system executes untrusted model-generated code; the paper abstract is not in the tree.
human_capability_summary.success_means: From the code: each node's overall_performance.accuracy_score (fraction of SWE-bench Verified or Polyglot instances resolved) recorded in metadata.json; the archive grows when children compile (non-empty patch, enough evaluated instances) and, under keep_better, when score >= initial score minus eval_noise; nodes scoring above a threshold (second-highest archive score, min 0.4) get a fuller evaluation. README itself names no metric beyond 'coding benchmarks'.
